english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when saying or doing something tactfully without being too direct.
Use this mainly when someone conveys a message, refusal, or criticism subtly and tactfully.

examples.english: I tactfully told them that the plan had to be changed.
examples.traditional: 我婉轉咁同佢講，份計劃要改。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jyun2 zyun2 gam3 tung4 keoi5 gong2 fan6 gai3 waak6 jiu3 goi2

examples.english: They subtly turned down my invitation.
examples.traditional: 佢婉轉咁拒絕咗我嘅邀請。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 jyun2 zyun2 gam3 keoi5 zyut6 zo2 ngo5 ge3 jiu1 cing2
